subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add an opt-in mode to ingest every Space message, and should that mode use Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, user OAuth, app authentication, or stay unsupported for now?
rationale: The remaining request changes which Space messages can reach OpenClaw, what Google credentials and scopes are stored, and how subscriptions are provisioned, so automation should not choose the privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer All-Message Ingestion
options.body: Document Google Chat as mention/webhook-only for now and revisit only if maintainers explicitly accept broader Space visibility later.

options.title: Track OAuth Separately
options.body: Let focused thread fixes proceed separately while using the open Google Chat OAuth issue for shared credential-model decisions.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from recent Google Chat code ownership and prior review on this security/product boundary.
